propositions: rebar review is a single-pass LLM operation superseded from above by the signed review-plan gate and from below by deterministic checks (clarity-check, check-ac, quality-check), and must be retired without breaking external callers.

The CLI verb rebar review must become a loud deprecation shim that forwards to review-plan with --no-sign to preserve read-only semantics, rejects --graph and positional reviewer_id arguments, and documents the fast-fail divergence on non-claimable tickets.

Three deprecation rows (cli, lib, mcp) must be registered in the central _deprecations.REGISTRY with scheduled removal in v1.0.0, each emitting exactly one warning signal at its boundary (stderr for CLI, DeprecationWarning for library, log for MCP).

The public rebar.llm.review_ticket library function must split into _review_ticket_impl + a warning facade to prevent double-signalling in the MCP tool, eval harness, and diff harness while keeping the library op callable and deprecated.

Four derived artifact generation sources (index.json from prompt front-matter, ticket_quality.md front-matter as writer fixed point, cli-reference.md from gen_cli_reference.py, mcp-reference.md from tool docstrings) must remain in sync after moving review descriptions and correcting output schema mappings.
